_comment: Translations of the German table kampf_k24, written by tools/i18n/locales_kampf_k24.py. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns.

strings.+%d%% power for each Energy spent on art: 本場戰鬥中每在招式上花費1點能量，威力+%d%%，最多%d點。
strings.A Soaked Spirling loses 2 Energy at the: 濕透的Spirling在每回合結束時失去2點能量。
strings.A Spirling that fought and waits on the: 出戰過並在替補席等待的Spirling每回合也獲得1點能量。換人就是有不在場證明的休息。
strings.A Spirling that has fought gains %d Ener: 已經出戰過的Spirling在替補席等待時，每回合獲得%d點能量。
strings.It has paid too much to stop now. Every: 已經付出太多，停不下來了。本場戰鬥中每在招式上花費一點能量，命中就更重一分。
strings.Pick Rest: it skips its art but gains 2: 選擇休息：它會跳過招式，但在回合的1點之外再得2點能量。對手可不會禮貌地等著。
strings.The water seeps into %s: it loses %d Ene: 水滲進了%s：它失去了%d點能量！
strings.Tip: Watch the pips fill back up. Restin: 提示：看著能量格重新填滿。休息才能讓能量回家。
strings.Tip: Your Spirling is running low on Ene: 提示：你的Spirling能量快不夠了。付不起的招式放不出來。
